causal_definition: Candidate utility, incumbent entry utility, decision timestamps, incumbent scheduled exit timestamps and the +0.05 utility hurdle were available or structurally defined at the historical decision timestamp. The comparison asks whether a later candidate was causally stronger than an incumbent still occupying capacity.
hindsight_only: The candidate's eventual net_r and win/loss/flat outcome are used after the historical decision solely to measure regret and are not used to reconstruct ranking or eligibility.
interpretation: The existing protected-only recycle layer leaves measurable temporal allocation regret. This is a repair surface, not permission for blanket risk expansion or hindsight selection. Any displacement rule must remain causal, risk-neutral, factor-bounded and full-universe replayed before promotion.
